title: Delegated SAML metadata validation and admin guardrails for SSO setup
creator: Nina Patel
description: Add a hardened SAML 2.0 setup flow that supports delegated (operator-assisted) metadata ingestion, signed metadata validation, and admin guardrails for creating/updating identity providers. This ticket covers the backend validation pipeline, UX signals for dangerous metadata, RBAC checks for connector creation, and audit events tied to metadata operations. Goal: allow enterprise admins to safely onboard IdPs via uploaded or retrieved metadata while preventing misconfiguration, silent downtimes, and metadata rollback attacks.
acceptance_criteria: The setup wizard accepts metadata via upload, URL fetch, or manual paste and runs a deterministic validation pipeline including XML schema verification, signature validation, entityID consistency, and certificate lifetime checks.
If validation fails, the UI surfaces clear, actionable errors with exact failing checks and remediation hints; telemetry records failure reason.
Only users with the 'connector.admin' RBAC role can create or replace an IdP connector; non-admins can only request connectors which create a pending task in the admin queue.

All metadata create/update/delete operations produce audit logs with: actor, timestamp, operation, entityID, certificates (thumbprints), source (upload|fetch|paste), previous connector id/version, and successful/failed status.
A canary rollout behind a feature flag deploys to 5% of orgs; fallback policy automatically disables new connector if 5xx SSO errors exceed threshold over 5 minutes.
Automated unit/integration tests cover signed metadata parsing, multiple-key signing, clock skew tolerances, and corrupted XML edge cases.
Documentation page (Confluence) and admin help text explain certificate rotation, metadata refresh intervals, and steps to recover from a failed exchange.
tasks: Design validation pipeline: XML schema -> signature verification -> certificate chain and expiry checks -> entityID and ACS URL heuristics
Implement server endpoint to fetch remote metadata with retry/backoff and content-type checks
Add upload and paste handlers that sandbox XML parsing to prevent XXE and other XML attacks
Integrate RBAC check: 'connector.admin' guard on create/replace/delete; implement pending-request flow for non-admins
Emit structured audit events to the audit-log stream and ensure retention policy is applied
Add UI states in setup wizard: preview metadata, highlight risky elements (wildcard ACS, expired certs, unsigned metadata), provide accept/decline path
Create automated validation library with comprehensive test vectors (valid signed metadata, expired cert, missing keyInfo, multiple signatures)
Add metrics: metadata_validation_latency, metadata_validation_failures_by_reason, metadata_fetch_errors, sso_connector_replacements
Write integration tests against a local SAML test IdP that exercises swapping metadata certs and rotating signing keys
Prepare rollout plan and feature flag gating; coordinate with Support Docs team for help content
comments: 2026-03-02 Nina Patel: Kickoff — captured initial threat model and sketch for validation pipeline. Noted previous incidents where expired certs caused customer outages (INC-2025-11).

2026-03-04 Marco Alvarez: Proposed using xmlsec for signature verification; will add an abstraction so we can swap implementations for on-prem builds. Linked POC repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/saml-validate-poc/pull/7

2026-03-05 Security review (prelim) by Aisha Khan: flagged XXE risks and recommended strict parser flags + content-type enforcement. Also recommended logging thumbprints but not full cert raw to avoid PII leakage.
2026-03-08 UX feedback from Jing Wu (PM Design): add a metadata preview pane and an explicit 'trusted by admin' banner; make replace action a two-step confirmation with displayed thumbprint.

2026-03-10 Marco Alvarez: Implemented fetch endpoint and basic validation flow in branch feat/saml-metadata; added unit tests for schema validation. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/5123
2026-03-11 Ops note from Leo Fernandez: ensure metadata fetch respects org region and solves cross-region fetch timeouts; suggested configurable fetch timeout per org.
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind ff.sso.metadata_validation_v2. Phase 1: internal orgs + 5% self-serve orgs for 48h; monitor metadata_validation_failures_by_reason and sso_error_rate. Phase 2: enable for all orgs with opt-out for on-prem customers. If failure rate > 1% or SSO error spike detected, auto-disable and alert on-call.
test_plan: Unit tests for XML parser hardening and signature validation; seed with known bad inputs
Integration tests with samltest.id (public test IdP) and a local SAMLP simulation to exercise fetch/upload/paste flows
Chaos test: rotate signing certificates in test IdP and observe our rotation handling and rollback path
E2E test: full login flow using newly-created connector, assert session creation and successful SSO login
Security fuzzing: run malformed XML corpus and assert system does not crash or leak secrets
audit_logging_requirements: All metadata operations must write structured events to the audit topic with fields (actor, org_id, operation, entity_id, thumbprints, source, request_id, previous_version_id). Events retained minimum 1 year and are queryable in Console Audit view. Sensitive certificate material must be redacted; only SHA256 thumbprints stored in plain text.
